newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends weak, cocoa firmer, sugar down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends weak, cocoa firmer, sugar down.

text.p: COFFEE - Reverses from highs, slips under trade and origin selling following weak NY. Jan ends $26 down at $1,433. COCOA - March eases after vaulting 1,000 stg barrier. Sentiment fragile ahead of Ivorian crop. Up seven stg on day at 999. SUGAR - Nearbys stay weak after disappointing New York performance. Dec down 40 cents at $319.40 at 1607 GMT.
